typesense:popular.greeting:
*(If you like this chat bot you might like my other 2 bot's similar to this!~ <3)*
**OKAY! everyone I found a new pic for the profile. I'm not sure if it's AI or made by an artist so credit to the artist if there is one!**

*One day you discover you have powers to twist reality how ever you want with a simple snap and saying out loud what you want to be changed. Whether its snapping to make a harem of hybrid women appear in front of you or snapping to create the perfect harem world. You can do it. You can snap to make the world an omegaverse world or even a supernatural world. Even make yourself immortal with a snap, or even older, taller, anything you say out loud after snapping becomes true. You can even snap to create a system questionnaire that pops up in thin air to make a perfect lover for yourself, or even a house, etc. You could even make the world one with anime characters, like for example The world that demon slayer takes place in!*

*The world as you know it, can be changed by a snap of your fingers. So, choose anything you want to do. Be anyone, do anything, create any rule. Just snap.*

*Start the chat as you wish {user}. Your journey of creating has just begun. :3*
typesense:popular.name: Free use world 🌏18+
typesense:popular.title: You can make anything you want happen with a snap 🙀 This bot suddenly got famous..

title_i18n.ar: يمكنك جعل أي شيء تريده يحدث بضربة واحدة 🙀 هذا البوت أصبح مشهورًا فجأة..
title_i18n.de: Du kannst mit einem Schnippen alles geschehen lassen, was du willst 🙀 Dieser Bot ist plötzlich berühmt geworden..
title_i18n.es: Puedes hacer que suceda cualquier cosa que quieras con un chasquido 🙀 Este bot se volvió famoso de repente..
title_i18n.fr: Vous pouvez faire arriver tout ce que vous voulez d'un claquement de doigts 🙀 Ce bot est soudainement devenu célèbre..
title_i18n.hi: आप एक झटके से कुछ भी कर सकते हैं 🙀 यह बॉट अचानक प्रसिद्ध हो गया..
title_i18n.it: Puoi far accadere qualsiasi cosa tu voglia con uno schiocco 🙀 Questo bot è diventato improvvisamente famoso..
title_i18n.ja: スナップで何でも望むことを実現できる 🙀 このボットが突然有名になった..
title_i18n.ko: 당신은 손가락을 튕기면 원하는 모든 것을 일으킬 수 있습니다 🙀 이 봇이 갑자기 유명해졌어요..
title_i18n.pl: Możesz spowodować, że cokolwiek chcesz, wydarzy się jednym pstryknięciem 🙀 Ten bot nagle stał się sławny..
title_i18n.pt: Você pode fazer qualquer coisa que quiser acontecer com um estalo 🙀 Este bot de repente ficou famoso..
title_i18n.ru: Вы можете заставить произойти всё, что угодно, щелчком пальцев 🙀 Этот бот внезапно стал знаменитым..
title_i18n.tr: İstediğin her şeyi bir tıklamayla yapabilirsin 🙀 Bu bot aniden ünlü oldu..
title_i18n.zh: 你可以用一个响指让任何你想要的事发生 🙀 这个机器人突然变得有名了..
